function: Federated multi-agent DDPG/DQN controlling satellite and BS beamformers, radar covariances, receive beamformers, and RIS phase shifts to maximize sum rate under target SINR constraints (p. 5-6).
system: Satellite-terrestrial downlink ISAC: GEO satellite and BS each with 4 Tx/4 Rx antennas, 4 users, 2 targets; 64-element reflecting RIS at the BS; 28 GHz Ka-band (p. 3, 9).
method: Federated multi-agent DDPG (F-DDPG) and DQN (F-DQN): per-zone agents with two hidden layers of 256 neurons, reinforcement learning, periodic digital aggregation at a gateway server (p. 6-9).
data_channel: Own simulator: GEO channel with free-space loss, beam pattern and log-normal rain fading after [41]; terrestrial LoS channel, path loss -103.6 dB; 100 channel realizations (p. 3-4, 9).
test_conditions: Trained 5,000 episodes of 10 slots; results averaged over 100 channel realizations; sweeps of power, RIS elements, antennas, users, SINR thresholds, CSI error, interference; no unseen condition (p. 9-13).
baselines: Non-learned: random RIS phases, no RIS, no-sensing reference; learned: F-DQN, DQN, F-PPO, plus centralized and non-federated DDPG/DQN variants (p. 9-10).
metrics: Average sum rate (bits/s/Hz), reward convergence, beampattern gain, execution time in seconds, data exchanged (p. 9-13).
complexity: Order O(E·T·Ct) from actor and critic layer sizes (p. 8); execution time in seconds, federated versus centralized, Fig. 9 (p. 11).
q1_support: p. 3: "encompasses free space loss, the radiation pattern of the antenna, and rain attenuation"; own simulator after [41] with a LoS terrestrial channel (p. 9), no 3GPP TR 38.811 model, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 12: "The results show a noticeable decline in performance with increasing CSI estimation uncertainty."; only sweeps (power, RIS size, antennas, users, CSI error) over averages of 100 realizations, no model tested in an unseen condition.
q3_support: p. 9: "the RIS adopts a random passive beamforming"; p. 10: "federated proximal policy optimization (F-PPO) as a benchmark"; sum rate against random RIS, F-DQN, DQN and F-PPO (Figs. 5-6).
q4_support: p. 8: "The overarching computational complexity of the algorithm across all iterations is therefore expressed as"; Fig. 9 (p. 11) gives execution times.
q5_support: p. 9: "100 distinct channel realizations"; simulated data, no link to code or data in the paper.
notes: Area 6 rather than 5: the satellite agent controls beamforming of a GEO link that also senses, and 6 outranks 5. The federated learning aggregates digitally at a gateway (p. 6-7), so it is not area 7. q3: non-learned baselines are random RIS and no RIS (p. 9); learned baselines are F-DQN, DQN and F-PPO (p. 9-10); centralized and non-federated DDPG are variants of the proposed method and are not counted. The satellite channel follows [41]; TR 38.811 appears only as a background reference in the introduction (p. 1-2), not as the channel model. Table II and figure legends read from page images (p. 9-11, 13).
